title: Learning piecewise-smooth dynamical systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.19785v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Discovering dynamical systems from trajectory data is a central problem in applied mathematics and engineering. Whilst recent advances in machine learning have led to strong progress in data-driven system identification, much less attention has been given to systems with discontinuous dynamics. These systems are nevertheless highly relevant in applications, including climate dynamics and mechanical systems with friction. In this work, we consider the problem of identifying piecewise-smooth dynamical systems directly from trajectory data. Compared with the smooth setting, this requires recovering the governing equations and detecting the switching hyperplanes that separate different dynamical regimes and characterising their behaviour, such as sliding motion. translated_title: 学习分段光滑动力系统
translated_abstract: 摘要：从轨迹数据中揭示动力系统是应用数学和工程领域的核心问题。尽管机器学习的最新进展在数据驱动的系统辨识方面取得了显著成果，但对具有不连续动力学的系统关注较少。然而，这些系统在应用中高度相关，包括气候动力学和含摩擦的机械系统。在本工作中，我们考虑直接从轨迹数据中识别分段光滑动力系统的问题。与光滑情形相比，这需要恢复控制方程、检测分隔不同动力学区域的切换超平面，并刻画其行为，如滑动运动。我们提出一个模块化框架，用于发现此类系统：首先从数据中估计切换超平面，然后利用几何方法在每个区域内学习光滑动力学。
tldr: 本文提出一个模块化框架，直接从轨迹数据中识别分段光滑动力系统，通过先估计切换超平面再分区域学习动力学，有效处理不连续系统识别问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a modular framework to identify piecewise-smooth dynamical systems directly from trajectory data by first estimating switching hyperplanes and then learning dynamics within each region, addressing the challenge of discontinuous system identification.
